description: This file defines a serializer class that skips all encountered fields and includes extension methods for skipping fields within a reader, as well as internal mechanisms to handle different wire types during serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: SkipFieldCodec
classes.description: A serializer that skips all fields it encounters during serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: SkipFieldExtension
classes.description: Contains extension methods for Reader to facilitate skipping fields based on wire types.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Method intended to write a field to a buffer, but currently not implemented.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads and skips a field value, returning null.

methods.name: SkipField
methods.description: Skips the current field in the reader based on the wire type.

methods.name: ThrowUnexpectedExtendedWireType
methods.description: Throws an exception for an unexpected ExtendedWireType.

methods.name: ThrowUnexpectedWireType
methods.description: Throws an exception for an unexpected WireType.

methods.name: SkipLengthPrefixedField
methods.description: Skips a length-prefixed field by reading its length and skipping that many bytes.

methods.name: SkipTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Skips fields until encountering an end object marker.
